text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Thirteen people are being held by police in connection with a spate of ritual killings in southern Monze district.
- The national union of farmers has welcomed government's intention to withdraw itself from the supply of agricultural inputs and crop marketing.
- The government has awarded a road rehabilitation project in the capital Lusaka to a Japanese firm, the city's mayor Fisho Mwale said.
- External aid will remain a significant component of Zambia's budget for a long time, the Economics Association of Zambia said.
